projectDescription: Baza is an AI-powered personal knowledge management framework built on Obsidian that uses a Dual-Interface Architecture to give both humans and AI agents seamless, structured access to the same Markdown-powered knowledge base.
keyFeatures: Dual-Interface Architecture: same Markdown files serve both human Obsidian UI and machine-readable YAML metadata
AI Agent Swarm: named agents (Antigravity, Podruga, Archivist, Librarian, Jules) with distinct roles and routing rules
Memory Tier System: Working → Episodic → Semantic → Procedural memory lifecycle
bzm.py CLI: command-line tool for vault sync, audit, and Google Drive hot-mirroring
Voice Notes Pipeline: 2-tap Apple Voice Memos → cloud webhook → formatted Markdown routing
Nightly Maintenance: automated GitHub Actions for link checking, deduplication, and report generation
Vector Search: Chroma DB integration with structured metadata schema for semantic retrieval
Tri-Modal Knowledge Graph: MOC scaffolds + YAML property links + narrative wikilinks
00-Inbox Drop-Off Office: zero-friction note capture that agents process and file automatically
Google Drive Hot Mirror: real-time vault mirroring for mobile/Gemini app access
publicApiSurface: bzm.py sync — synchronize vault to Google Drive mirror
bzm.py audit — run vault health check (duplicates, broken links)
bzm.py start / checkpoint / end — session lifecycle commands
00-Inbox/ — drop-off zone for all new notes
YAML frontmatter schema: type, status, confidence, last_verified, up, down, related
